definition.delay_s: controller-local advancement time minus referee gate-crossing time.
definition.false_local_advancement: A local increment precedes its same-ordinal referee crossing by more than one configured dt, or has no corresponding referee crossing.
definition.missed_local_advancement: A referee crossing has no same-ordinal local increment in the run.

provenance.changed: The audit was rescoped from every executed run to the released run set. The previous artifact aggregated all 78 executed runs of the frozen matrix, which included 10 strong-current Horseshoe Bay runs that the manuscript reports nowhere; the audited population therefore did not match the population the manuscript describes. Dropping those 10 runs moves the overall counts from referee 1474 / local 1472 / matched 1467 / false 11 / missed 7 to referee 1443 / local 1440 / matched 1437 / false 9 / missed 6.
provenance.delay_statistics: Retained here in full, including min, max and std, but no longer tabulated: tab:local_vs_referee now reports only the advancement counts. The delay distribution has a long negative tail (overall min -90.849 s against a median of 0.858 s), which a two-number median/p95 summary would conceal.
provenance.previous_scope: all 78 executed benchmark runs of the frozen 20260715 matrix, including 10 strong-current Horseshoe Bay runs not reported in the manuscript
provenance.recomputed_from: results/onboard_only_validation/final_20260715 (the frozen raw run tree, which is not part of this released package)
provenance.reproduces_previous_artifact: Under the same definitions and the same one-control-step tolerance, the recomputation reproduces the previously published 78-run aggregate exactly, field for field, on the overall block and on all three per-circuit blocks. The figures in this artifact are that same computation restricted to the released runs.
provenance.std_convention: advancement_delay_s.std is a population standard deviation, as in the previously published artifact; the manuscript's table convention (ddof=1) is not used here.

scope: the 68 released benchmark runs of the frozen 20260715 matrix, that is the same population as benchmark/runs.csv; this is an information-boundary audit of controller-local against referee course progression, not a per-condition result
